integrity: Exact-rational finite checks supplement an analytic proof. The preceding finite-horizon theory is not contradicted. No independent audit or validation has been performed; unindexed equivalent derivations remain a priority risk.
limitations: Real unit-frequency harmonic oscillator, position-first symplectic Euler, independent identically distributed steps in a compact subset of (0,2), exact arithmetic; the conclusion concerns second-moment growth over an infinite number of updates, not almost-sure behavior or arbitrary geometric integrators.
title: Random-step symplectic Euler has a sharp mean-square instability dichotomy
